text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

BARLEY SALE - Saudi Arabia has bought 1.2 million tonnes of optional-origin barley at a maximum price of $161 per tonne, cost and freight, European traders said on Wednesday. The barley is for February and March delivery.

CORN AND SOYBEAN SALE - State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp bought a combined shipment of 20,000 tonnes of No.2 or better U.S. yellow corn and 10,000 tonnes of No.2 or better U.S. yellow soybeans from Mitsui at a tender, traders said.

WHEAT SALE - The CCC of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it bought 30,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for donation to Bosnia. The wheat was bought from Farmland Industries Inc at $176.74 a tonne, FOB Galveston, Texas. Shipment was slated for January 25-February 20.

WHEAT TENDER - Korea Flour Milling Corp said on Wednesday it passed on tenders for 17,300 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat due to high prices. A company official said arrival was set for the port city of Mokpo. The company official said shipment was slated for March 1-31 from the Pacific Northwest.

WHEAT TENDERS - South Korea's Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd and Cheiljedang Corp have jointly invited tenders for a total of 21,500 tonnes of U.S. wheat by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Thursday. Shipment was set for Feb 20-March 20 to Pusan.

- Lebanon's economy ministry plans to buy 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard wheat later this month on the international market, the Cereals and Sugar Beet Office said. "We plan to buy 50,000 tonnes of wheat. It will be Hard Red Winter No.2," the official said. "We are supposed to buy it later this month for delivery at the end of February but we still do not have all the details for the tenders."

WHEAT TENDERS - Armenia is seeking about 65,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the PL 480 program for January 23-February 6 delivery, its U.S. export agent said. Offers are to be submitted on January 15 and will be valid until January 16.
- Slovenia is expected this week to tender for 40,000 to 50,000 tonnes of Canadian or U.S. wheat, several U.S. exporters said. Arrival was slated for February 28.
- Taiwan will tender this Thursday for about 85,000 to 86,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for January-February delivery, several U.S. exporters said.
WHEAT TENDERS - Pakistan will tender January 12 for 315,000 tonnes of Australian white milling wheat and U.S. soft white wheat. Shipment was slated for February 1-28.

- Bangladesh seeks 100,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 wheat or Australian standard or better Canadian winter red/spring wheat for shipment by February 21. Offers are to be opened January 18 and the results announced two to three days later.

BARLEY TENDER - The Cyprus Grain commission on Wedneasday invited tenders for the supply of 25,000 tonnes feed barley with a shipment period between January 15 and 30. The tender closing date is January 10, the grain commission said.
SOYMEAL TENDER - South Korea's Korea Feed Association will invite tenders for 125,000 tonnes of soymeal on Monday. The tenders were divided into four positions for March 20.
SOYBEAN OIL TENDER - The CCC is to tender for 10,370 tonnes of U.S. bulk crude degummed soybean oil for donation to Peru. Delivery was for Feb 3-18. Offerers will be notified Jan 8.

SOYBEAN MEAL - The Commodity Credit Corp of the U.S. Agriculture Department said it seeks offers from exporters for 2,650 tonnes of 48 percent protein soybean meal for donation to Guatemala. Shipment is slated for between January 30 and February 25, 1997. Offers are due on January 14 at 1400 CST.
RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foostuffs is seeking to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for March shipment. Results would be Feb 13.

- The Japanese Food Agency said it would buy about 60,000 tonnes of rice at an import tender on January 9. In a General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade deal in 1993, Japan agreed to open its rice market, pledging to buy 455,000 tonnes of foreign rice in fiscal 1996/97, which ends on March 31.
MARKET TALK - Thailand and Malaysia bought about 100,000 tonnes of corn from Argentina as regional business picked up after the holiday period, traders said.

... India's state-run State Trading Corporation said on Wednesday it has contracted to import 1.25 million tonnes of wheat in 1996/97 (April-March), with the first shipments expected to arrive later this month.
... Saudi Arabia is estimated to have imported 700,000 tonnes of rice in 1996 mostly from India, the United States, Thailand and Pakistan, a Saudi newspaper on Wednesday quoted importers as saying.
